Keep the laptop UpdateFunctionCode deploy, but add reproducible packaging and a placeholder-SHA verification gate
decisions.recommended: Move code into the template via S3 artefacts, with GitHub Actions CI and an OIDC deploy role
decisions.answer: Keep the laptop UpdateFunctionCode deploy, but add reproducible packaging and a placeholder-SHA verification gate

decisions.title: Should backups capture unpublished (draft) content?
options: Keep includeDrafts: true and remove the inert deliveryToken, its SSM read and its IAM grant
Switch to published-state only: drop includeDrafts and keep the delivery token
Produce two artefacts per run, one draft-inclusive and one published-only

decisions.answer: Switch to published-state only: drop includeDrafts and keep the delivery token

decisions.title: How far to take backup-store durability in this spec
options: Full: cross-account and cross-region replication plus S3 Object Lock, accepting a bucket migration
Same account, second region replication, plus Object Lock only if it can be enabled in place
Lifecycle and bucket-policy hardening only, with replication and Object Lock parameterised for later
decisions.recommended: Full: cross-account and cross-region replication plus S3 Object Lock, accepting a bucket migration
decisions.answer: Lifecycle and bucket-policy hardening only, with replication and Object Lock parameterised for later

decisions.title: Monitoring approach, given content changes are weeks to months apart
options: CloudWatch alarms and custom metrics as originally specced (about $5/month)
No alarms or metrics at all: event-driven email on failure only, plus a monthly scheduled backup as the liveness probe
decisions.recommended: No alarms or metrics at all: event-driven email on failure only, plus a monthly scheduled backup as the liveness probe
decisions.answer: No alarms or metrics at all: event-driven email on failure only, plus a monthly scheduled backup as the liveness probe

decisions.title: Liveness detection after scheduled backups were ruled out on Contentful quota grounds
options: No proactive detection at all: rely solely on failures of attempted backups
Coverage_Check in the Filter_Lambda: compare last content change against newest backup object on each build, consuming no Contentful quota
decisions.recommended: Coverage_Check in the Filter_Lambda: compare last content change against newest backup object on each build, consuming no Contentful quota
decisions.answer: Coverage_Check in the Filter_Lambda: compare last content change against newest backup object on each build, consuming no Contentful quota

excluded_from_scope: Phase 0 git/branch protection work (already completed by the user)
Phase 6 restore runbook, restore drills and DR scope
CloudWatch alarms, custom metrics, metric filters and dashboards (cost and alert fatigue)
agent_decisions: Keep the Amplify SNS trigger as the sole trigger; defer any Contentful-webhook migration
No scheduled, periodic or synthetic backups at all: Contentful API quota is scarce and shared with editorial work and the PaddelBuch and CloudyPandas frontend builds
Staleness alarm rejected outright: no threshold can separate a long quiet period from a dead system
Scheduled liveness backup rejected: it would spend Contentful quota purely to prove the system works

Coverage_Check adopted instead: the Filter_Lambda compares last content change against the newest backup object on each build, reading the website's static API and S3 only, so it costs no Contentful quota and stays silent during quiet periods by construction
Failure notification by two event-driven paths: the backup function self-reports caught errors, a DLQ-triggered notifier covers timeouts and out-of-memory kills
LongTermStorageClass remains a deploy-time parameter; document the Glacier thaw implication rather than choose a class
adm-zip bumped to a patched version immediately, then replaced by a streaming library when the buffered upload becomes a stream
No Lambda alias: CloudFormation cannot manage an alias pointing at $LATEST, and a script-updated alias reintroduces drift
KMS CMK recorded as a deliberate deferral with rationale; SSE-S3 retained
Test-only CI retained (no deploy, no OIDC, no Contentful calls) since nothing currently runs the suite
open_items_gated_on_first_deployment: Whether the identity-policy KMS grant suffices for the AWS-managed SNS key; fallbacks ranked in design pass 1, acceptance test is the commissioning publication
The size and duration envelope, and therefore final MemorySize and EphemeralStorageSize; produced by the one-time commissioning export
